checks: Expanding the affine margins at the positively weighted base barycenter cancels the base offsets and uses the common contact to give u_j dotted with the continuous barycenter displacement.
The embedding u ↦ (t_l u)_l is injective since the weights are positive. Both dependence spaces coincide and a positive balance gives at least one nonnegative margin at every ambient product point.

The common flat is precisely the preimage of the projected mark. The map to the normal span is surjective. For an interior target image, the extension past it and the original interior point give a strict convex combination that is interior in the full product.

Only at rank d can projected interiority be identified with interiority of the specified y in the Minkowski interpolant. The interpolant is included in the actual real fiber by convexity. This makes no claim that the barycenter base is integer.

overlap.comparison: Its convolution proof uses the weighted-sum margin cancellation at an integer base and the weighted source centroid. It does not give the arbitrary real contact's simultaneous lifted relation space or the interior criterion for the common flat at lower rank.

readability: The rank is the span of continuous normals, and all interiors after projection are relative to that span.
review_method: Independent mathematical proof review of the frozen normalized candidate
summary: The lifted circuit has the stated rank and relation space, and projection of the product interior gives the exact contact criterion.
